24:59.text: And when the children among you reach puberty, let them ask permission
as those before them have done. Thus does Allāh make clear to you His verses; and Allāh is Knowing and Wise.

24:60.text: And women of post-menstrual age who have no desire for marriage - there is no blame upon them for putting aside their outer garments
not displaying adornment. But to modestly refrain
is better for them. And Allāh is Hearing and Knowing.

24:61.text: There is not upon the blind
constraint nor upon the lame constraint nor upon the ill constraint nor upon yourselves when you eat from your

houses or the houses of your fathers or the houses of your mothers or the houses of your brothers or the houses of your sisters or the houses of your father's brothers or the houses of your father's sisters or the houses of your mother's brothers or the houses of your mother's sisters or
of your friend. There is no blame upon you whether you eat together or separately. But when you enter houses, give greetings of peace
upon each other - a greeting from Allāh, blessed and good. Thus does Allāh make clear to you the verses
